verdict.rationale: Fastmail can be automated headlessly over HTTP. It documents API tokens and an API documentation page, and its JMAP API uses standard OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens with a discoverable session endpoint. A single POST can query, fetch and send, which fits non-interactive scripts and CI jobs. A community user also reports scripted sending via SMTP with a restricted app password. missing for 10: no official CLI or CI-specific guidance/examples, the API-token help page is evidenced only by its title, no hands-on corroboration of JMAP automation against Fastmail, and community notes rate limits unsuited to scale.
